title: Sphere packing in 8D fell to a short proof
body: Maryna Viazovska proved in 2016 that the E8 lattice is the densest sphere packing in eight dimensions, with a proof startlingly short by modern standards, extending days later to dimension 24 with collaborators. Packing optima are known only in dimensions 1, 2, 3, 8 and 24. The universe of dimensions is mostly unmapped territory with a few lit shrines.
source_hint: Viazovska (2016), E8 and Leech lattice packings
